title: AI Writes Code, Humans Pay the Debt. An Empirical Study on the Sustainability and Evolution of Agent-Generated Code
abstract: arXiv:2609.04208v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Context. The increasing adoption of Generative AI coding agents in software engineering is transforming how developers implement and maintain code. While these systems provide short-term productivity benefits, their long-term impact on software quality and technical debt remains unclear. Aim. We aim to investigate how agent-generated code affects software quality, focusing on issue localization accuracy, the introduction of technical debt, and its evolution over time. Method. We will conduct a large-scale mining software repositories study using the SQuaD dataset, employing a candidate set of 628k issue tickets. We will generate agent-based implementations for these issues, and compare them with the actual commits done by developers using static analysis metrics and tools. We will analyze differences at the commit level and across releases, and we will consider multiple LLM-based Agents selected through a systematic benchmarking strategy

translated_title: AI编写代码，人类偿还技术债：关于代理生成代码的可持续性与演化的实证研究
translated_abstract: 背景：生成式AI编程代理在软件工程中的日益普及正在改变开发者实现和维护代码的方式。虽然这些系统能够带来短期的生产力提升，但它们对软件质量和技术债的长期影响仍不明确。目的：我们旨在研究代理生成的代码如何影响软件质量，重点关注问题定位准确性、技术债的引入及其随时间的演化。方法：我们将使用SQuaD数据集开展大规模的软件仓库挖掘研究，采用包含62.8万条问题工单的候选集。我们将为这些问题生成基于代理的实现，并使用静态分析度量指标和工具将其与开发者的实际提交进行比较。我们将在提交级别和跨发布版本层面分析差异，并将考虑通过系统化基准测试策略筛选出的多个基于大语言模型的AI代理。
tldr: 该研究计划通过大规模挖掘软件仓库，将AI代理生成的问题修复代码与开发者实际提交进行静态分析对比，以实证评估代理生成代码对软件质量和技术债的长期影响。
en_tdlr: This study plans to conduct a large-scale mining software repositories analysis that compares AI agent-generated code with actual developer commits using static analysis, in order to empirically assess the long-term impact of agent-generated code on software quality and technical debt.
